title: Universal Tab Drag-to-Switch & Zero-Jump Fluid Release Physics
summary: Brings smooth iOS-style touch drag-over gestures and tactile detents to all tab and segmented controls across the app, with zero-jump fluid spring release physics.

changes.text: Zero-Jump Post-Drag Physics: replaced instantaneous transform resets with smooth cubic-bezier spring release animations from the finger's exact release coordinates, eliminating post-drag jumps across mobile navigation and scanner tabs.
Optimistic Mobile Navigation: preserved target tab highlight and indicator positioning through client-side routing so the indicator never snaps back to the previous route while loading.

Touch Drag on Pill Tabs: enabled continuous drag-over tab switching with variable-width thumb tracking and detent haptics on PillTabs (category filters, rarity filters, character element tabs, and weapon type tabs).
Touch Drag on Glass Segmented Controls: brought fluid 120fps drag tracking, tactile boundary clicks, and smooth spring release to GlassSegmentedControl.
